Power: Lasts the day for me (as in from morning to night, not 24 hours) -- note that I am not very sweaty person and do not have a bad issue with body odor, so it isn't that impressive. reviews.t: Suckered in by the funny commercials
reviews.x: Ok, so this product is awful. If you want to smell like the wonderful scent of this deodorant and then smell like gorgonzola cheese as soon as possible then this is the deodorant for you. I have never had an issue with body odor, and for the 2 weeks I used this deodorant, I smelled like a homeless person.  Do yourself a favor and do not buy this product. Ever. I'll stick to Mitchum unscented gel, at least i know i don't smell liked rotten cheese 15 minutes after applying.

reviews.t: This product does what is claims to do
reviews.x: Advertising experts say you have to see or hear an ad at least seven times before you start considering it.  I must have seen the Lume ad at least that many times before I finally broke down and bought it.  Two aspects of their claim really intrigued me.  First of all, they said you could use it on any part of your body, not just armpits.  Second, they said it fights odor for 72 hours.  I had to try this stuff!  I wish it cost a little lest, but after buying, I have become hooked.  I don't think

reviews.t: Could not get past the smell.
reviews.x: I had really high hopes for this deodorant. However, once I received it and smelled it, I just could not. It smelled horrible. Like vomit.  It was so horrible I was not able to determine the effectiveness. I thought I would try a different scent but then I went online and saw that many others had the same complaint about the smell. I think I'll just leave this alone.

I don't know how to put this but it doesn't have a lime scent.... if you don't mind smelling.like a fresh rolled blunt then this is for you. It's last for a while and doesn't break me out like other deodorant. On to get a different scent.
It smells so bad. Having body odor is better than this smell

Honestly, it worked okay to get me through much of my day, but the smell was so unbearable, I couldn't stand to use it after showering. After a couple of weeks, I had to abandon it. reviews.x: The ‘Bay Rum’ scent is actually revolting. I put it on as soon as I got it, excited to try Lume for the first time. I didn’t like the scent when I first opened it, but thought maybe it would smell better on my skin. I was so wrong. I smelled like the dumpster behind an Italian restaurant. I left it on for a while, paranoid that everyone around me would think I had forgotten how to bathe after I’d made rancid spaghetti. reviews.t: The odor of the product is worse than any odor it is meant to cover or prevent
reviews.x: I was enthusiastic about the concept of this product when I ordered it. I liked its consistency when I first opened it. I tried it for three days running, hoping to get used to the odor. BUT the underlying odor (  never did a tangerine smell like this - I live in Florida) was worse than anything it was to cover, or prevent,  threw it away immediately, a waste of $15. I installed a bidet on my toilet seat, it eliminates odor by excretions, and missed matter. If I could give a minus review, I woul

I have sensitive skin and I’ve been wanting to try this product since I saw it advertised on social media. It worked great the first few days And then by day four or five I started noticing my armpits getting red and by the weekend I had a horrible burning rash under my armpits. I used a very small amount And got to a point that I could not use it any longer because my armpits felt like they were on fire. And no I had not shaven so it wasn’t from razor burn or anything.

It works great for my crotch area,  less great for my armpits.  Certain scents seem to work less than others (for instance,  I don't even bother with Lavender Sage because I start to stink within a few hours. But jasmine rose has lasted 48 hrs)... of course I'm not sure if that's a scent thing or just inconsistency in the product.  Overall I like the product.  I smell less than I did before using it.  Just feel like the results are inconsistent.

There aren’t any cons. I’ve seen some comments saying the scent isn’t good. I couldn’t disagree more. If you’re the type of person that thinks Apple Bee’s serves good ribs then you probably won’t appreciate it. However, if you’re slightly more refined than a Neanderthal, not unlike myself, then you’ll probably find these agreeable.

The scent is definitely more for males or maybe someone who is outside in the woods every day?? I’m much more of a floral scent type gal! reviews.t: Works great, don’t try bay rum
reviews.x: It actually works very well! Probably one of the best deodorants I’ve tried. However, I tried the bay rum scent and the smell was absolutely disgusting.  I’ll try a different one but I wouldn’t recommend bay rum.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the scent unpleasant or offensive, describing it as rancid, vomit-like, or gag-inducing.
Several reviewers report the product fails to control odor or does not last, with body odor returning within hours.
Some reviewers experienced skin irritation, rashes, or darkening under the arms.
A few reviewers praise the formula for being gentle on sensitive skin and working as claimed.
Some reviewers consider the price too high for the quality received.
